6428.description: AI-powered trade execution API for autonomous agents. Supports 20+ blockchains including Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, MegaETH, Polygon, Solana, and more. Returns unsigned transaction data for agent wallets (Openclaw, Lobster, Coinbase Agentic, etc.) to sign and broadcast. Features: token swaps, cross-chain bridging, limit orders, DCA, perpetuals, prediction markets, and Quick Intel security scanning on every trade. Sync and async modes supported.
6428.unpayable: it settles on eip155:8453, not BNB Smart Chain
